sql: select lo.strategy, date_trunc('day', lo.created_at)::date d, count(*)::text orders, count(c.id)::text with_ctx, count(*) filter (where c.id is null)::text missing from live_orders lo left join execution_order_context c on c.live_order_id=lo.id where lo.kalshi_order_id is not null and lo.created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-20 00:00:00+00' group by 1,2 order by 2 desc, 1
